$description: DTCG source for the design-system tokens. GENERATOR FILE: /playground writes it during ingest. design/tokens.css is the derived, frozen runtime source of truth; when they differ, the CSS file takes precedence until the owner deliberately reconciles it. Each token records its source and reliability under $extensions.provenance. A 'low' confidence means the value is an estimate; follow-up prompting is expected, not a bug.

accent.$description: Example token. Demonstrates the expected structure, including provenance; the generator replaces it.

provenance.note: Neutral placeholder that lets the template run on its own. No target brand.

provenanceSchema.source: code-library | figma | live-site | spec | screenshot | manual | template-placeholder
provenanceSchema.sourceRef: Package version, Figma node ID, URL, or file path supporting the value
provenanceSchema.usage: How often the value occurred in the source (declaration count, node count, or 0 for placeholders); required
provenanceSchema.id: Stable short identifier derived from role + value (for example, a short hash) so later re-ingests can be diffed; required
provenanceSchema.evidence: Brief evidence (for example, a measured computed style), otherwise null
